title: One-cover refinement of a pointed inverse system
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a category with a site precoverage $P$ satisfying the site axioms [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]. Let $J$ be a nonempty directed preorder-category, let $V:J^{op}\to\mathcal C$ be an inverse-system diagram, and let $F$ be a sheaf of sets on $P.toGrothendieck$. Thus the stalk is $\varinjlim_J (V^{rightOp}\mathbin{\triangleright}F.val)$ and, for $W\in\mathcal C$, $u'(W)=\varinjlim_J(V^{rightOp}\mathbin{\triangleright}\operatorname{yoneda}(W))$. Let $K$ be a finite type, let $\{W_k\xrightarrow{wk_k}W\}_{k\in K}$ be a covering, let $s\ne s'$ in $\varinjlim_J(V^{rightOp}\mathbin{\triangleright}F.val)$, and let $f\in u'(W)$. Then there are a nonempty directed preorder-category $I$, an inverse-system diagram $U:I^{op}\to\mathcal C$, an order embedding $e:J\hookrightarrow_o I$, and an identification $e\mathbin{\triangleright}U^{rightOp}=V^{rightOp}$ such that the two images of $s,s'$ under the canonical map $\operatorname{colimit.pre}(U^{rightOp}\mathbin{\triangleright}F.val,e)$ are distinct, and for some $k\in K$ the image of $f$ under the canonical map $\operatorname{colimit.pre}(U^{rightOp}\mathbin{\triangleright}\operatorname{yoneda}(W),e)$ lies in the range of the map induced by $\operatorname{yoneda.map}(wk_k)$ from $\varinjlim_I(U^{rightOp}\mathbin{\triangleright}\operatorname{yoneda}(W_k))$ to $\varinjlim_I(U^{rightOp}\mathbin{\triangleright}\operatorname{yoneda}(W))$. The displayed Yoneda colimits use the canonical universe lift when the category and hom universes differ.

proof.text: By clause (1) of [lem-weil-pbc-filtered-colimit-sets-elementwise], choose $j_0\in J$ and a representative $f':V_{j_0}\to W$ of $f$. Let $J_0=\{j\in J\mid j\ge j_0\}$; it is directed, and the canonical map from the colimit over $J_0$ to the colimit over $J$ is bijective by the elementwise criterion (every index admits an upper bound in $J_0$, and equality is witnessed at a later index). For each $j\in J_0$ and $k\in K$, form $V_{j,k}=V_j\times_{W,f'\circ g_{jj_0}}W_k$. The fibre products exist and $\{V_{j,k}\to V_j\}_{k\in K}$ is a covering by axiom (iii) in [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology].

source.place: Tag 00YO (Lemma lemma-refine), proof: first paragraph, representation of f and construction of V_{j,k}

proof.text: For every $j\in J_0$, the sheaf equalizer condition in [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] makes the restriction map $\mathcal F(V_j)\to\prod_{k\in K}\mathcal F(V_{j,k})$ injective. These maps commute with the transition maps in $j$, and a filtered colimit of injective maps of sets is injective by clause (3) of [lem-weil-pbc-filtered-colimit-sets-elementwise] (two elements with equal image are equal after some transition, hence equal by injectivity at that index). Hence, after passing to filtered colimits, [lem-weil-pbc-filtered-colimits-commute-finite-limits] identifies the map $\mathcal F_{p'}\to\prod_{k\in K}\varinjlim_{j\in J_0}\mathcal F(V_{j,k})$ with an injective map (the finite product is a finite limit). Since $s\ne s'$, their images differ in at least one coordinate; choose $k_0\in K$ for which their images in $\varinjlim_{j\in J_0}\mathcal F(V_{j,k_0})$ are distinct.

source.place: Tag 00YO (Lemma lemma-refine), proof: sheaf restriction injection, Categories Lemma 002W, and choice of k

proof.text: Construct the refined index poset as the disjoint union $I=J^{(0)}\amalg J_0^{(1)}$. Put $j^{(0)}\le j'^{(0)}$ and $j^{(1)}\le j'^{(1)}$ exactly when $j\le j'$ in $J$, put $j^{(0)}\le j'^{(1)}$ exactly when $j\le j'$, and impose no relation $j^{(1)}\le j'^{(0)}$. Set $U_{j^{(0)}}=V_j$ and $U_{j^{(1)}}=V_{j,k_0}$. The poset is directed: an upper bound for two indices is obtained by choosing in $J_0$ an element above their underlying indices and taking its $(1)$-copy. Define transition maps for an order relation by $g$ on two $(0)$-copies, by the pullback of $g$ along $W_{k_0}\to W$ on two $(1)$-copies, and, for $j^{(0)}\le j'^{(1)}$, by the projection $V_{j',k_0}\to V_{j'}$ followed by $g_{j'j}$; these maps satisfy the identity and composition laws by the pullback universal property. The $(0)$-copy of $J$ is the original subsystem, so this is a refinement of the given system.

source.place: Tag 00YO (Lemma lemma-refine), proof: construction of I=J\amalg J_0, ordering, objects and transition maps

proof.text: The $(1)$-copy $J_0^{(1)}$ is cofinal in $I$, so the elementwise filtered-colimit criterion [lem-weil-pbc-filtered-colimit-sets-elementwise] identifies the colimit over $I$ with the colimit over $J_0$ of the sets $\mathcal F(V_{j,k_0})$. Therefore the images of $s,s'$ remain distinct by the choice of $k_0$. For every $j\in J_0$, the projection $V_{j,k_0}\to V_j$ followed by $g_{jj_0}$ and $f'$ factors through $W_{k_0}$ by the pullback definition. Thus the image of $f$ in $u(W)$ is represented by a morphism through $W_{k_0}$, proving the required conclusion.

split_report.summary: Split the one-cover refinement of Tag 00YO into four steps. Step 1 represents the given morphism in a tail of the directed system and forms the pullbacks along the finite covering. Step 2 uses the sheaf equalizer injection and filtered-colimit commutation with finite products to choose one cover member preserving distinctness. Step 3 gives the full disjoint-union index poset and all transition maps omitted in the source. Step 4 uses cofinality of the refined summand to preserve distinctness and verifies the factorization through the selected cover member.

statement_change.old_statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a site [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]. Let $(J,\geq,V_j,g_{jj'})$ be a directed inverse system of objects of $\mathcal C$: $J$ is a nonempty directed poset, each $j\geq j'$ has a transition $g_{jj'}:V_j\to V_{j'}$, and $g_{jj}=\mathrm{id}$, $g_{j'j''}g_{jj'}=g_{jj''}$. Put $u'(W)=\varinjlim_{j\in J}\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal C}(V_j,W)$ and $\mathcal F_{p'}=\varinjlim_{j\in J}\mathcal F(V_j)$ for a sheaf of sets $\mathcal F$ on $\mathcal C$ (filtered colimits of sets [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]). Let $s\ne s'$ in $\mathcal F_{p'}$, let $\{W_k\to W\}_{k\in K}$ be a covering of $\mathcal C$ with $K$ finite, and let $f\in u'(W)$. Then there is a directed inverse system $(I,\geq,U_i,f_{ii'})$ of objects of $\mathcal C$ refining the given one, i.e. $J\subset I$, the order of $J$ is the one induced from $I$, $U_j=V_j$ and $f_{jj'}=g_{jj'}$ for $j\geq j'$ in $J$, such that the images of $s,s'$ under the canonical map $\mathcal F_{p'}\to\varinjlim_{i\in I}\mathcal F(U_i)$ remain distinct and the image of $f$ under the canonical map $u'(W)\to u(W)=\varinjlim_{i\in I}\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal C}(U_i,W)$ lies in the image of $u(W_k)\to u(W)$ (composition with $W_k\to W$) for some $k\in K$.
statement_change.what: The landed statement describes the system, the stalk, u, u' and the refinement only informally (an implicit subset J of I, implicit canonical maps u'->u and F_{p'}->F_p, and an unspecified notion of finite covering and sheaf of sets on a site). The correction states the same Tag 00YO content with these objects explicit: the site as a precoverage satisfying the site axioms, the sheaf on P.toGrothendieck, the inverse system as a diagram over a directed preorder (Stacks' directed set, Categories 002V), the refinement as an order embedding with an identification of the restricted diagram, the canonical maps as colimit.pre, and the factorization through u(W_k) as membership in the range of the map induced by yoneda.map(wk_k), with the canonical universe lift of the representables. No hypothesis is added and no conclusion clause is weakened.

lean.statement: theorem pointSystemRefine {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] (P : Precoverage C) (hP : P.IsSiteForCoverings) {J : Type w} [Preorder J] [Nonempty J] [IsDirected J (· ≤ ·)] (V : Jᵒᵖ ⥤ C) (F : Sheaf P.toGrothendieck (Type (max w t))) {K : Type r} [Finite K] {W : C} (Wk : K → C) (wk : ∀ k, Wk k ⟶ W) (hcover : Presieve.ofArrows Wk wk ∈ P W) (s s' : colimit (V.rightOp ⋙ F.1)) (hs : s ≠ s') (f : colimit (V.rightOp ⋙ uliftYoneda.{w}.obj W)) : ∃ (I : Type w) (_ : Preorder I) (_ : Nonempty I) (_ : IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)) (U : Iᵒᵖ ⥤ C) (e : J ↪o I) (h : e.toOrderHom.toFunctor ⋙ U.rightOp = V.rightOp), (((eqToHom (congrArg (fun X : J ⥤ Cᵒᵖ => colimit (X ⋙ F.1)) h).symm) ≫ colimit.pre (U.rightOp ⋙ F.1) e.toOrderHom.toFunctor) s ≠ ((eqToHom (congrArg (fun X : J ⥤ Cᵒᵖ => colimit (X ⋙ F.1)) h).symm) ≫ colimit.pre (U.rightOp ⋙ F.1) e.toOrderHom.toFunctor) s') ∧ (∃ k : K, ∃ g : colimit (U.rightOp ⋙ uliftYoneda.{w}.obj (Wk k)), colimMap (U.rightOp.whiskerLeft (uliftYoneda.map (wk k))) g = ((eqToHom (congrArg (fun X : J ⥤ Cᵒᵖ => colimit (X ⋙ uliftYoneda.{w}.obj W)) h).symm) ≫ colimit.pre (U.rightOp ⋙ uliftYoneda.{w}.obj W) e.toOrderHom.toFunctor) f)
